description: A single-panel line plot of strain hardening versus true stress for two annealing conditions of the 2Al steel (one composite-free plot; no micrographs or insets). The x-axis is labelled "True Stress (MPa)" spanning 400-1800 MPa in 200 MPa major ticks; the y-axis is labelled "Strain Hardening (GPa)" spanning 0-5 in 1 GPa ticks. The legend lists two curves: a black line "2Al-450°C/1h" and a red line "2Al-650°C/72h". Both curves start near the top of the y-axis (~5 GPa) at ~500 MPa and fall steeply; they overlap almost exactly through the first hardening stage up to roughly 1 GPa, then diverge. A vertical dashed line at about 1080 MPa separates the text annotation "first hardening stage" (left) from "second hardening stage" (right). The black curve redescends gently and flattens into a plateau near 1.9-2.0 GPa between ~1100 and 1600 MPa before a sharp terminal drop. The red curve falls faster and terminates at ~1.3 GPa near 1100 MPa, never entering the second stage. The caption states tensile deformation at an initial strain rate of 5×10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ for Fe–30.5Mn–2.1Al–1.2C (wt.%).

subfigures.description: Line plot of Strain Hardening (GPa, 0-5) vs True Stress (MPa, 400-1800) with two curves: black '2Al-450°C/1h' and red '2Al-650°C/72h'. A vertical dashed line at ~1080 MPa divides the annotated 'first hardening stage' from the 'second hardening stage'. The black curve shows a plateau at ~1.9-2.0 GPa up to ~1600 MPa; the red curve ends at ~1.3 GPa near 1100 MPa.

observations.observation: The plot has x-axis 'True Stress (MPa)' from 400 to 1800 and y-axis 'Strain Hardening (GPa)' from 0 to 5.
Two curves are shown with legend entries '2Al-450°C/1h' (black) and '2Al-650°C/72h' (red).
A vertical dashed line at approximately 1080 MPa separates regions annotated 'first hardening stage' (left) and 'second hardening stage' (right).
Up to about 1 GPa true stress the black and red curves overlap, defining a common first hardening stage that falls from ~5 GPa to ~2 GPa.
Only the black curve ('2Al-450°C/1h') extends into the second hardening stage, flattening to a plateau near 1.9-2.0 GPa between ~1100 and ~1600 MPa.
The red curve ('2Al-650°C/72h') diverges downwards after ~1000 MPa and terminates at roughly 1.3 GPa near 1100 MPa, without a second regime.
The caption states the tensile tests were performed at an initial strain rate of 5×10⁻⁴ s⁻¹.
The caption states the alloy is 2Al: Fe–30.5Mn–2.1Al–1.2C (wt.%).
The citing text states fracture of the long annealed sample occurs at a macroscopic true stress of 1150 MPa, corresponding to the onset of the second hardening regime of the short annealed alloy.
The citing text states the short annealed alloy has UTS 935 MPa and UE 75%, attributed to multiple-stage strain hardening.
The citing text states the long annealed alloy exhibits limited elongation (UE = 35%).
The citing text states the long annealed alloy shows a single hardening regime that overlaps the first regime of the short annealed alloy up to about 1 GPa.
The citing text estimates the twinning stress as σ_twinning ~ 670-750 MPa (assuming γ = 60 mJ m⁻², b = 0.25 nm, Taylor factor 2.8-3.2).
